$comment: What an outside tool reaches on bench/ground-truth.json by FILE AND LINE. These numbers are pinned by scripts/gates/gate-external-crosscheck.sh: the committed raw output is re-adapted and re-scored on every run, and a silent change in the adapter, in the answer key or in the raw files moves one of them and the gate goes red.
$comment_what_a_hit_means: LOCATION agreement, not semantic agreement. A finding counts as detecting a planted defect when it points inside the span the key declares for it. A tool that lands on the right line for the wrong reason is a hit here. That is the limit of this measurement and it is declared, not hidden.
$comment_status: The tool reports its candidates as `open`; they are recorded as `probable`, which is what score.py counts as reported. An unadjudicated candidate still reaches the user's screen, so counting it is the honest choice - and it is the choice that charges the tool for its false positives as well as crediting its hits.

default.$command_note: run once per case: <scan-root> is bench/cases/<case> in THIS repository and <run-dir> a scratch directory outside it. Only <run-dir>/findings.json is kept, under raw/default/<case>.findings.json.
